policies.label: doc first
policies.summary: If the tool name, schema, permission or side effect is unclear, block until the manual is checked.

policies.label: read only fast path
policies.summary: Read-only tools may run quickly, but output must be bounded and summarized.

policies.label: mutation proposed action
policies.summary: Mutating actions must declare goal, scope, risk, validation and rollback.

policies.label: high risk approval
policies.summary: High-risk actions require ApprovedAction or equivalent human confirmation.

policies.label: result summary
policies.summary: Every tool execution writes status, evidence, errors, next steps and FAME update candidates.

policies.label: negative lesson
policies.summary: Failures are retained as project memory and negative FAME candidates.
